core_obligations: Build the direct infinitary-formula translation into labelled tuple trees, and construct parameterized computable embeddings respecting prescribed finite tree shapes to obtain the complexity-preserving reverse translation.

Use reverse translation for the lower rank bound, and combine translated tuple-orbit predicates with a finite subtree skeleton and branch replication to extend the resulting local subtree isomorphisms to a global tree automorphism for the upper bound.
